hero.subtitle: A crash on Rosecrans, Imperial Highway, or any Norwalk street can leave you sorting out medical bills and insurance calls at the same time. LawProactive connects you, at no cost, with an independent attorney who handles car accident claims in Los Angeles County.

about.title: Norwalk Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Norwalk sits where several busy routes cross, and its collision records show it. In 2025 the city logged 413 injury collisions, with 546 people hurt and seven traffic deaths. Public-record counts run highest along Rosecrans Avenue, Imperial Highway, Pioneer Boulevard, and Studebaker Road, and reports cluster on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. as commuters head home across Los Angeles County. If one of those crashes upended your life, you deserve clear information before anyone asks you to sign anything. California gives most injured drivers and passengers two years to file, but that window can shrink to six months when a city, county, or state agency may share responsibility. Pure comparative fault also means partial blame does not erase your claim; it only reduces recovery by your percentage. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Norwalk residents with an independent attorney who reviews the facts and handles the case on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Norwalk Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines are tracked from day one
items.desc: California's two-year filing window feels long until a government vehicle or road condition is involved and the clock drops to six months. An attorney in our network sorts out which deadline applies before it becomes a problem.

items.title: Partial fault is not the end of your claim
items.desc: Under pure comparative fault, you can still recover even if you were partly responsible for the collision. Your attorney works to establish an accurate split rather than the one the other insurer proposes.

items.title: Evidence is protected and statements are handled carefully
items.desc: Dashcam footage, nearby business cameras along Pioneer or Studebaker, and repair estimates can disappear quickly. Network attorneys move to preserve them and speak to the other driver's insurer so you are not pressed into a recorded statement.

items.question: I was hit near the Imperial Highway and Pioneer Boulevard area during Friday rush hour. What should I do first?
items.answer: Get medical attention even if you feel only stiffness, because many crash injuries show up a day or two later. Photograph the vehicles, the intersection, and any signal or lane markings, and collect names of witnesses who stopped. Report the crash to the Norwalk Sheriff's station or CHP as appropriate, then reach out before giving the other driver's insurer any recorded account.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company keeps calling. Do I have to give them a recorded statement?
items.answer: No, you are not required to give a recorded statement to the other party's insurer. Those recordings are often used to question your injuries or shift fault under California's comparative fault rules. An attorney can handle that communication so your words are not taken out of context.

items.question: How does LawProactive get paid if the service is free?
items.answer: You pay LawProactive nothing, ever. The independent attorney you are connected with works on a contingency basis, meaning their fee comes only out of a recovery if there is one. If there is no recovery, you owe no attorney fee.
